description.text: There will be three extrance examinations until the end of September. After applicants submit their application materials successfully, you will get the notice to take the exam as soon as possible.

duration.text: The Ethics at Yunnan University of Finance and Economics is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3194 USD/per year ￥ 23000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 6 or above 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7. Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief.

requirements.text: Study plan Including study purpose, research interest and research plan in brief.
